environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to close the shared "global" namespace on this server. Every call that routes there is refused before the request is sent, and the tools stop offering it as an example. Unset leaves it available. A value that is neither a yes nor a no stops the server rather than being read as no.
environmentVariables.name: NOETIVE_DISABLE_GLOBAL_NS

environmentVariables.description: An OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint you run. Set it and embeddings are computed on this machine rather than by Noetive: a publish carries the vector alongside its text, and a query's anchor phrases are replaced by vectors so they are never sent. This is not confidential publishing: message text still travels, because that is what a search returns. The endpoint must answer to the same model name as NOETIVE_MODEL and return NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS values. Plain http is accepted only for a loopback address. Inside a container 127.0.0.1 is the container itself; use host.docker.internal.
environmentVariables.name: NOETIVE_EMBEDDINGS_URL

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for that endpoint, when it needs one. Endpoints running on your own machine usually do not.
environmentVariables.name: NOETIVE_EMBEDDINGS_KEY_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Path to the riffle executable, when it is not on PATH. With riffle installed the server also offers its browser tools. Unset and not found means no browser tools; set and unusable stops the server. Not available in the container image, which has no browser.
environmentVariables.name: NOETIVE_RIFFLE_BIN

environmentVariables.description: Where the mail tools reach Bud, https://bud.noetive.io by default. Must be https, or http to this machine, because the API key goes with every request; anything else stops the server.

tools.name: get_coverage_stats
tools.summary: Live coverage of the ERC-8004 agent economy (Base/Ethereum): agents indexed, how many expose a live MCP server / OpenAPI / well-known card, total tools and methods observed, contracts verified, owners identified, per-chain breakdown. Counts only — no names, addresses, or handles.

tools.name: get_leaderboards
tools.summary: Top ERC-8004 agents by live MCP tool count and by OpenAPI method count, plus the most-recently indexed — each with agent_id, chain, public name, shareable detail URL, and the relevant count. Names and counts only.

tools.name: get_agent_summary
tools.summary: Objective counts-only signals for one agent: reachability, TLS validity, x402 support, payments-received (boolean), MCP tool count, OpenAPI method count, well-known presence, owner-named (boolean), and a neutral status label. Vet a counterparty agent before transacting.

tools.name: get_network_teaser
tools.summary: A capped teaser (<=200 nodes) of the on-chain agent-to-agent payment graph: connected agents and the value flowing between them. Truncated preview of the full paid graph.
